summary.text: Glenn D. Jeffries is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 8, listed with Putnam County; the district covers Roane and Clay counties and parts of Kanawha, Putnam, Jackson and Wirt. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Economic Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jeffries' page lists his education as Poca High School and West Virginia State University and his occupation as businessman.
It names his spouse as Sherry G. Jeffries and lists four children and three grandchildren.

His affiliations include membership on the Putnam County Economic Development Authority's Operations Committee and the Putnam County Chamber of Commerce, and a trustee role with the Carpenters Pension and Health Funds of West Virginia and the Painters Health Fund and Apprenticeship and Training Funds of West Virginia.
Jeffries also serves on the Senate's Energy, Industry and Mining, Enrolled Bills, Finance, Government Organization, Natural Resources and Transportation and Infrastructure committees.
Between sessions he chairs the interim Committee on Flooding as well as the interim Economic Development committee.
